title: Rate Review Schedule — Length-of-Residence Reduction of the Independent Living Late Fee Percentage
content:
Length of residence lowers the late fee percentage applied on an Independent Living Residency Agreement account.

Length of residence is counted in **whole calendar months from the move-in date to the day of assessment**.

| Whole calendar months in residence | Lowering of the late fee percentage |
|---|---|
| 84 months or more | 0.5 percentage point |
| 36 months or more but fewer than 84 months | 0.25 percentage point |
| Fewer than 36 months | Nothing |

The lowering is subtracted from the late fee percentage, the result never going below zero, before the percentage is applied to the past-due amount of the billing period.

## Boundary rows (hypothetical dates)

A whole calendar month is complete on the same day number as the move-in date.

| Move-in date | Day of assessment | Whole months | Lowering |
|---|---|---|---|
| August 15, 2019 | August 14, 2026 | 83 | 0.25 point |
| August 15, 2019 | August 15, 2026 | 84 | 0.5 point |
| May 3, 2023 | May 2, 2026 | 35 | Nothing |
| May 3, 2023 | May 3, 2026 | 36 | 0.25 point |

## Illustration (hypothetical)

A late fee percentage of 2.25 for a resident with 90 whole months in residence is lowered by 0.5 point to 1.75 percent before it is applied to the past-due amount.
